title: Weighted norm bound from pairings
statement:
Let $I$ be a finite set, let $w_i\ge 0$ for each $i\in I$, let $q>1$, let $z:I\to\mathbb R$, and let $N\ge 0$. If every function $g:I\to\mathbb R$ satisfies
\[
\sum_{i\in I}w_i z_i g_i\le N\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|g_i|^{q/(q-1)}\right)^{1/(q/(q-1))},
\]
then $\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|z_i|^q\right)^{1/q}\le N$.
hypotheses_covered: The pairing bound holds for every $g:I\to\mathbb R$
replaced: Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$, $q>1$, $z:I\to\mathbb R$, and $N\ge0$. If $\sum_iw_iz_ig_i\le N(\sum_iw_i|g_i|^{q/(q-1)})^{(q-1)/q}$ for every $g:I\to\mathbb R$, then $(\sum_iw_i|z_i|^q)^{1/q}\le N$.
